## Requirements for Authorship

1.  Assisted on experiment and/or data collection

2.  Provides feedback on manuscript drafts

    1.  Responds to emails when feedback is required

    2.  If there is no response from a co-author after two weeks or
        three attempts to contact, they will be listed in the
        acknowledgements and no longer remain a co-author.

3.  Approves author agreement

## AI Use in Manuscript Coding

1.  No AI use Proofreading: No AI use
2.  Writing/drafting: No AI use
3.  Reference management: No AI use
4.  Conceptual outlines: No AI use
5.  We ask that when reviewing the manuscript you avoid using AI

    Pespeni, Matthew Sasaki
2.  Sydney Sharp will be first author as the main driver of the project
